blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — Four people were killed in two separate vehicular accidents involving pineapple-hauling trucks in Manolo Fortich and Kadingilan, Bukidnon, on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18 and 19).
